categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Matches 'Tests' label and modifies test/functional/interface_bitcoin_cli.py to eliminate a spurious CI test failure.
categories.rationale: Fixes a flaky functional test failure occurring under Docker CI load. According to the PR description, 'the process can return a few tens of milliseconds early (~40ms observed), so the floor assert flakes', and this introduces scheduling slack to resolve the spurious failure.
